sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of these actions helps build a strong and happy community?
options: D) Ignoring people who need help

questions.question_text: What instrument helps us find the four main directions in our neighbourhood?
Which of these foods provides us with the maximum energy for playing and running?
What do you call a path through a forest or park made to observe plants and animals?
How do plants primarily help human beings stay alive and grow healthy?
options: A) They provide oxygen and food
D) They eat all our food
questions.answer: A) They provide oxygen and food

questions.question_text: When neighbours gather to celebrate a local festival together, it shows a spirit of:
A map of a neighbourhood uses small pictures to represent real places. These pictures are called:
To build strong bones and teeth, which mineral is most important in our diet?
While walking on a nature trail, if you see a beautiful butterfly resting on a leaf, you should:
options: A) Catch it in a jar
B) Throw a small stone at it
C) Observe it quietly from a distance
questions.answer: C) Observe it quietly from a distance

questions.question_text: Growing a small kitchen garden at home is a wonderful way to:
options: A) Waste a lot of water
B) Connect with nature and get fresh vegetables
questions.answer: B) Connect with nature and get fresh vegetables

questions.question_text: Why is it important to have good neighbours in our community? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Good neighbours act like an extended family. They help us during emergencies, share our joys during festivals, and make the community a safe, happy place.

questions.question_text: How do landmarks help us explore and navigate our neighbourhood easily? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Landmarks are well-known places or large objects, like a hospital or a big tree. They act as clear reference points to help people find specific addresses.

questions.question_text: Name two essential items you should carry on a nature trail and explain why. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You should carry a water bottle to stay hydrated and a magnifying glass to observe tiny insects or detailed leaf patterns closely without harming them.

questions.question_text: How does spending time outdoors in nature help us stay healthy? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Spending time outdoors gives us fresh, clean air to breathe, sunlight for Vitamin D, and wide spaces to play, which keeps our bodies active.

questions.question_text: What is a balanced diet and why is it absolutely necessary for children? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A balanced diet includes the right amounts of carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals. It is necessary because it helps children grow properly and fight diseases.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are drawing a map of your neighbourhood for a new friend. Describe four important symbols you will use and what they stand for. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would draw a red cross to show the hospital, a small envelope for the post office, and an open book for the school. Finally, I would use a green tree symbol to represent the park where we can play together.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are packing a healthy lunchbox for a school picnic. Describe the food items you will choose and how they help your body. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I will pack a vegetable sandwich on whole wheat bread for energy. I will add a boiled egg for protein to build muscles, and a fresh apple for essential vitamins. I will also carry a bottle of water to stay hydrated.

questions.question_text: Explain how a community can work together to create a greener and cleaner neighbourhood. Give specific examples of actions they can take. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A community can organize weekly cleanliness drives to pick up litter from streets. Neighbours can plant saplings around their houses and take turns watering them. They can also set up separate dustbins for dry and wet waste, and start a compost pit to naturally fertilize the soil.

questions.question_text: Describe how traditional farming practices help protect nature while also providing us with nutritious food. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Traditional farming uses natural animal manure instead of harmful chemical fertilizers, keeping the soil healthy and fertile. Farmers use natural methods to control pests and rely on rainwater for irrigation. This protects local water sources from pollution and provides us with fresh, organic crops that are safe to eat.
